why: arXiv:2412.10686 (Dec 2024) by Zhipeng Deng proposes 'A General Solution to Bellman's Lost-in-a-forest Problem', and a follow-up arXiv:2606.13987 (2026) titled 'Proof and More Variations of Bellman's Lost-in-a-forest Problem' claims to prove that general solution and extend it; both target the problem exactly as stated (unknown shape's boundary escape path, unknown start point and orientation).
